summary: preinstall/postinstall exfiltrate installer identity to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: mw-test-utils@10.0.0 ships preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts that fire automatically on `npm install` and send HTTP GET requests to the hardcoded bare-IP, plain-HTTP endpoint http://38.242.235.206/depconf/mw-test-utils/{preinstall,postinstall}. The requests carry installer identifiers harvested from the host — the OS username (process.env.USER / USERNAME), the hostname (os.hostname()), and the current working directory (process.cwd()) — as query parameters. The destination is a hardcoded non-first-party IP unrelated to any registry, publisher, or declared project infrastructure, and the data egress occurs without any opt-in. The package's self-description as an authorized dependency-confusion proof-of-concept does not change the installer-facing behavior: anyone who installs this version has their identity beaconed to an attacker-style bare-IP collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
